title: "Moved — the shift plan is warehouse-planning's (always 410)"
description: "Retired by ADR-0049 (stage C). The shift plan — rate × heads × hours on a process path with its `plannedHeads <= installedStations` invariant — is a planning decision and moved to warehouse-planning (its ADR 0023), which takes it as `PUT /labour-plans/{site_id}/{shift_id}/{path_id}`. This route commits nothing, publishes nothing and answers `410 Gone` with the problem type `shift-plan-moved` for any body; it disappears in stage E. The `Idempotency-Key` header is still checked first, as on every POST. The labor plan Workforce Management reports stays readable through `GET /paths/{pathId}/labor-plan-view`."

Retired by ADR-0049 (stage C). The shift plan — rate × heads × hours on a process path with its `plannedHeads <= installedStations` invariant — is a planning decision and moved to warehouse-planning (its ADR 0023), which takes it as `PUT /labour-plans/{site_id}/{shift_id}/{path_id}`. This route commits nothing, publishes nothing and answers `410 Gone` with the problem type `shift-plan-moved` for any body; it disappears in stage E. The `Idempotency-Key` header is still checked first, as on every POST. The labor plan Workforce Management reports stays readable through `GET /paths/{pathId}/labor-plan-view`.
